program.def:
def card(task, wd):
    now = 1790000000
    day = 86400
    results = [{'q': 'where is the aspect rule', 'nodes': ['ratio()'], 'outcome': 'useful', 't': now - 2 * day}, {'q': 'aspect width', 'nodes': ['ratio()'], 'outcome': 'useful', 't': now - 40 * day}, {'q': 'who renders', 'nodes': ['render()'], 'outcome': 'useful', 't': now - 1 * day}, {'q': 'font loader', 'nodes': ['load_font()'], 'outcome': 'dead_end', 't': now - 3 * day}, {'q': 'even sizes', 'nodes': ['even()'], 'outcome': 'corrected', 't': now - 5 * day}]
    store = wd / 'graphify-out/reflections'
    store.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
    for i, r in enumerate(results):
        (store / ('result_%02d.json' % i)).write_text(json.dumps(r), encoding='utf-8')

    def reflect(folder, half_life=30, min_corr=2):
        rows = [json.loads(p.read_text()) for p in sorted(folder.glob('result_*.json'))]
        agg = {}
        for r in rows:
            w = 0.5 ** ((now - r['t']) / (half_life * day))
            for n in r['nodes']:
                a = agg.setdefault(n, {'useful': 0, 'dead_end': 0, 'corrected': 0, 'weight': 0.0})
                a[r['outcome']] += 1
                a['weight'] += w if r['outcome'] == 'useful' else -w
        trusted = sorted((n for n, a in agg.items() if a['useful'] >= min_corr))
        tentative = sorted((n for n, a in agg.items() if 0 < a['useful'] < min_corr))
        dead = sorted((n for n, a in agg.items() if a['dead_end']))
        md = ['# LESSONS', '', '## Trusted'] + ['- %s (weight %.3f)' % (n, agg[n]['weight']) for n in trusted] + ['', '## Tentative'] + ['- ' + n for n in tentative] + ['', '## Known dead ends'] + ['- ' + n for n in dead]
        return ('\n'.join(md) + '\n', agg, trusted, tentative, dead)
    md, agg, trusted, tentative, dead = reflect(store)
    (store / 'LESSONS.md').write_text(md, encoding='utf-8')
    md2 = reflect(store)[0]
    w40 = 0.5 ** (40 / 30)
    empty = wd / 'empty'
    empty.mkdir()
    md_e, _, tr_e, te_e, de_e = reflect(empty)
    return ([check('ratio() corroborated twice -> trusted', trusted == ['ratio()'], trusted), check('render() seen once -> tentative', tentative == ['render()'], tentative), check('load_font() listed as a known dead end', dead == ['load_font()'], dead), check('30-day half-life weighting (2 d + 40 d answers)', abs(agg['ratio()']['weight'] - (0.5 ** (2 / 30) + w40)) < 1e-09, agg['ratio()']['weight']), check('reflect is deterministic', md == md2), check('negative control: with no saved results there are no lessons', not (tr_e or te_e or de_e))], [store / 'LESSONS.md'])

title: Understand any codebase or skill set fast

program.def:
def card(work):
    code = work / 'repo'
    code.mkdir()
    (code / 'core.py').write_text('def build():\n    return 1\n')
    for m in ('cli', 'render', 'export', 'lint'):
        (code / f'{m}.py').write_text('from core import build\nimport json\n')
    (code / 'render.py').write_text('from core import build\nimport export\n')
    edges = import_graph(code)
    deg = Counter((b for _, b in edges)) + Counter((a for a, _ in edges))
    god = deg.most_common(1)[0][0]
    sk = work / 'skills'
    for n, d in (('caption-ar', 'Arabic captions'), ('beat-cut', 'cut on beats')):
        (sk / n).mkdir(parents=True)
        (sk / n / 'SKILL.md').write_text(f'---\nname: {n}\ndescription: {d}\n---\n# {n}\nbody\n')
    idx = skill_index(sk)
    nfiles = 612
    gate = 'pick a subfolder' if nfiles > 500 else 'map whole repo'
    save(work, 'onboarding.json', {'edges': edges, 'god_node': god, 'skills': idx, 'size_gate': gate})
    return [eq('local import edges', len(edges), 5), eq('god node = core abstraction', god, 'core'), eq('skill index rows', [(r['name'], r['lines']) for r in idx], [('beat-cut', 6), ('caption-ar', 6)]), eq('>500 files -> subfolder', gate, 'pick a subfolder')]

checks.name: two communities split at the Lumo-Wadi bridge

program.def:
def card(work):
    chunks = {'c1': 'Amal founded Nexa. Amal leads Nexa.', 'c2': 'Nexa acquired Lumo. Lumo partners with Nexa.', 'c3': 'Karim founded Sahl. Sahl acquired Wadi.', 'c4': 'Wadi partners with Sahl. Karim leads Wadi.', 'c5': 'Lumo funds Wadi.'}
    ents, rels = extract(chunks)
    edges = sorted({tuple(sorted((a, b))) for a, _, b, _ in rels})
    comms, qv = modularity_communities(sorted(ents), edges)
    comms = sorted((sorted(c) for c in comms))
    summaries = [{'members': c, 'summary': ', '.join((ents[n]['name'] for n in c))} for c in comms]

    def local(entity):
        nb = sorted({b if a == entity else a for a, b in edges if entity in (a, b)})
        cids = sorted({cid for a, _, b, cid in rels if entity in (a, b)})
        return (nb, cids)
    nb, cids = local('karim')
    save(work, 'graph_rag.json', {'entities': {k: sorted(v['chunks']) for k, v in ents.items()}, 'edges': edges, 'communities': summaries, 'modularity': qv, 'local_karim': [nb, cids]})
    return [eq('entities merged across chunks', len(ents), 6), eq('two communities split at the Lumo-Wadi bridge', comms, [['amal', 'lumo', 'nexa'], ['karim', 'sahl', 'wadi']]), truth('modularity positive', qv > 0.3, round(qv, 3)), eq('local query: neighbours', nb, ['sahl', 'wadi']), eq('local query cites chunk ids', cids, ['c3', 'c4'])]
